notes: ESC/POS of receiptline's escpos command set. No unknown items: GS a and GS r, the status commands, and FS ( A, the Kanji font, are parsed since section 16c, none of them prints. receiptline writes the Code 128 of ESC/POS as the code set selection {C and the value of every digit pair, one byte each, and the one of StarPRNT as the digits themselves; the renderer reads {C the way the specification describes, so both draw the same symbol, see the notes of section 16.
